collection.title: Citroen C5 Saloon 2008 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Citroen C5 Saloon 2008 to 2017 model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
